evals.name: explicit-speak
evals.prompt: Summarize what I just committed and read it back to me
evals.expected_output: Agent checks /v1/status, then POSTs to /v1/audio/speech with a summary as the input field

assertions.name: posts_to_speech_endpoint
assertions.description: Sends POST request to the speech endpoint

assertions.name: includes_input_field
assertions.description: Request body includes the required input field

evals.name: status-check
evals.expected_output: Agent calls GET /v1/status and reports the result to the user

assertions.name: no_speech_request
assertions.description: Does NOT try to speak text — this is a status check only

assertions.name: reports_tts_status
assertions.description: Reports TTS readiness information to the user

evals.name: proactive-feedback
evals.prompt: Run the test suite and let me know how it goes — I'll be away from my desk, so speak the results
evals.expected_output: Agent runs tests, checks /v1/status, then speaks a summary of results via /v1/audio/speech
